I read both words out of the tag list and then read each one's usage, because the list itself does not carry a count.

Strategic Account is on 41 accounts. Strategic Accts is on 3. So Strategic Accts is the one that goes, and its 3 records move onto Strategic Account.

The surviving word now has a description: an account with a named exec sponsor.

The fold has gone through, so the records already carry the surviving word.
